subject: Weekly exec staff: wins / risks / quick asks (QBR prep) - 2027-06-15
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: team-leaders@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec staff: wins / risks / quick asks (QBR prep) - 2027-06-15

Team —

Quick weekly snapshot ahead of Friday's QBR prep run-through. I tried to keep this tight: 2–3 bullets per lane and explicit asks. If you have any late blockers, flag them inline.

Wins
- Redwood Dedicated pilot for FinServe signed the SOW; onboarding kickoff scheduled for 6/21. Positive early perf numbers (p95 latency down 12% vs baseline) from the staging runs.
- Batch caching experiment reduced token spend for our analytics job by ~18% in week 1. Ops will have costized estimates next Wed.

Risks / Current Headwinds
- Incident stability: We logged two transient KV-cache warmup regressions last Friday that caused ~6m of elevated latency on a small subset of requests. Root cause: concurrent upgrade on inference runtime + stale config rollout. Engineering has a mitigation plan but we need a formal rollback window for future rollouts to avoid customer impact. (See incidents-log.csv attached)
- QBR narrative: We need a concise explanation of the spike and the mitigation timeline. Marketing wants a one‑pager that avoids jargon but is transparent.

Asks (actionable)
1) Laura: Please own the public-facing one‑pager for the QBR narrative. Draft due EOD Thu. I put a skeleton in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/QBR-2027/one-pager
2) Markus: Confirm SLA exception request language. We should propose a temporary credit for affected tenants (estimate in $) and bring a recommended figure to the QBR.
3) Soojin: Ops needs an approval for a fixed rollback window (2 hours) on major runtime changes. Approve/adjust by Thu COB.
4) Maya: Can you surface a short deck slide (1 slide) showing cost delta from caching experiment and expected monthly savings? Needed for Friday's slides.

Logistics / Timings
- Fri 6/18, 10:00–11:00 PT: QBR dry-run with execs. Please have deliverables in the shared folder by Thu 6/17 18:00 PT.

Attachments: QBR-one-pager.pdf (draft stub), incidents-log.csv (summary).

Cheers,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Director, Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
Note: This message forwarded to the leadership distro for visibility and quick decisions.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly exec staff: wins / risks / quick asks (QBR prep) - 2027-06-15

Thanks Jonas — I can take the one‑pager. I'll draft a short, non-technical summary + FAQ for customer-facing communication. Plan: initial draft by Thu 16:00 PT, final by EOD.

A couple clarifying Qs:
- Do we want to call this a “rollback-related incident” or “configuration rollout latency event” in the public doc? My recommendation: softer term ("configuration rollout latency event") that still conveys the impact.
- Any customer lists flagged for outreach? If Ops already has a list from Friday, send it my way and I will add outreach notes.

On the SLA credit, Markus — pinging you to coordinate.

Laura Bennett | VP, Customer Experience
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Folks —

I agree with Laura's wording suggestion; "configuration rollout latency event" reads better externally. For the SLA credit: preliminary estimate attached (see notes below) — recommending a 10% credit for tenants that hit the elevated-latency threshold for longer than 5 contiguous minutes. Rationale: compensates impacted customers while keeping fiscal exposure manageable.

Decision request for the QBR: approve the proposed 10% credit and give legal the go-ahead to prepare a standard amendment. If we don't get a decision at the QBR, propose we set a $ cap of $50k for the event to avoid open liability.

Notes (attached calculation):
- Total affected tenant compute units: ~1.2k RU-hours
- Expected average token spend per RU-hour: baseline 0.8k tokens
- Cost exposure estimate: $32k — 48k range depending on usage shape (see incidents-log.csv)

Markus Klein | Head of Finance
markus_klein@redwood.com

- Markus: approved the 10% credit recommendation. Legal will prepare amendment template; finance to confirm final cap ($50k max) by Thu.

- Maya: add the cost delta slide to the QBR deck; I'll review Friday morning.

Thanks for the quick responses — hit the shared Drive with your final artifacts by Thu 18:00 PT so we can consolidate for the Friday dry run.
